newsitem.title: UK: SAFEWAY UP ON HSBC JAMES CAPEL COMMENTS.
newsitem.headline: SAFEWAY UP ON HSBC JAMES CAPEL COMMENTS.

text.p: Shares in supermarket groups Safeway Plc and Asda Group Plc rose on Tuesday after analysts at HSBC James Capel recommended "switching" out of J. Sainsbury Plc, sources said.
Safeway gained 4p to 388-1/2p by 0910 GMT in active trade of 2.2 million shares. Asda added 1-3/4 to 148p and Sainsbury dipped 1/2p to 438.

Market sources said the recommendation to switch into Asda and Safeway was partly due to the relative performance of the stocks and partly down to fears that Sainsbury was spreading it's wings too widely.
"There is concern that they (Sainsbury) are likely to invest more money in the U.S. rather than withdraw," the source said.
